messages.content: What are the names of proteins found in the plasma membrane?

function.name: cellbio_get_proteins
function.description: Get the list of proteins in a specific cell compartment. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

include_description.description: Set true if you want a brief description of each protein.

message.content:
Below is a representative list of proteins that are commonly found in the **plasma membrane** of mammalian (human) cells.  The list includes a mix of integral (transmembrane) proteins, peripheral membrane proteins, and lipid‑anchored proteins that play key roles in signaling, transport, adhesion, and cell–cell communication.

| Category | Protein (gene symbol) | Typical Function |
|----------|-----------------------|------------------|
| **Ion Channels** | **SCN5A** (Nav1.5) | Voltage‑gated Na⁺ channel – initiates action potentials in cardiac myocytes |
| | **KCNQ1** (Kv7.1) | Voltage‑gated K⁺ channel – regulates cardiac repolarization |
| | **CACNA1C** (Cav1.2) | L‑type Ca²⁺ channel – mediates Ca²⁺ influx in excitable cells |
| | **TRPV1** | Non‑selective cation channel – heat and capsaicin receptor |
| **Transporters / Channels** | **SLC2A1** (GLUT1) | Glucose transporter – basal glucose uptake |
| | **SLC5A1** (SGLT1) | Sodium‑glucose cotransporter – intestinal glucose absorption |
| | **SLC26A3** (DRA) | Cl⁻/HCO₃⁻ exchanger – intestinal electrolyte transport |
| | **CFTR** | ATP‑binding cassette chloride channel – cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator |
| **Receptors** | **EGFR** | Epidermal growth factor receptor – tyrosine‑kinase signaling |
| | **INSR** | Insulin receptor – metabolic regulation |
| | **TNFRSF1A** (TNFR1) | Tumor necrosis factor receptor – apoptosis & inflammation |
| | **NRG1R** (ErbB4) | Neuregulin receptor – neuronal development |
| | **GPCRs** (e.g., **ADRB2** β₂‑adrenergic receptor, **DRD2** dopamine D₂ receptor) | G‑protein coupled receptors – diverse signaling |
| **Adhesion Molecules** | **ITGB1** (β1‑integrin) | Cell‑matrix adhesion, signal transduction |
| | **CDH1** (E‑cadherin) | Homophilic cell‑cell adhesion in epithelial tissues |
| | **NCAM1** | Neural cell adhesion molecule – neuronal networking |
| | **ICAM1** | Intercellular adhesion molecule – leukocyte trafficking |
| **Lipid‑anchored Proteins** | **GPI‑anchored CD55** (DAF) | Complement regulatory protein |
| | **GPI‑anchored CD59** | Inhibits MAC formation |
| | **GPI‑anchored CD46** | Complement regulatory protein |
| **Peripheral Membrane Proteins** | **Annexin A2** | Binds phospholipids in a Ca²⁺‑dependent manner; involved in membrane repair |
| | **Caveolin‑1** | Scaffold protein of caveolae; involved in endocytosis and signaling |
| | **EHD1** | Endocytic recycling regulator |
| | **Dynamin‑1** | GTPase that drives vesicle scission during endocytosis |
| **Signal Transduction Complexes** | **LAT** (Linker for activation of T cells) | Adaptor protein in T‑cell receptor signaling |
| | **CD3ζ** | Part of the T‑cell receptor complex |
| | **Tetraspanins** (e.g., **CD9**, **CD81**) | Organize membrane microdomains and signaling platforms |
| **Other Functional Proteins** | **P2X7** | ATP‑gated ion channel involved in inflammation |
| | **SIRPα** | Signal regulatory protein alpha – “don’t eat me” signal to macrophages |
| | **MHC‑I** (HLA‑A, HLA‑B, HLA‑C) | Antigen presentation to cytotoxic T cells |
| | **MHC‑II** (HLA‑DR, HLA‑DP, HLA‑DQ) | Antigen presentation to helper T cells |

### How to get a more exhaustive list
If you need a comprehensive, up‑to‑date inventory of plasma‑membrane proteins for a specific cell type or organism, you can use the `cellbio_get_proteins` function:

```python
cellbio_get_proteins({
    "cell_compartment": "plasma membrane",
    "include_description": True
})
```

This will return a structured list of proteins annotated to the plasma membrane, along with brief functional descriptions.
